messages.subject: Planned maintenance: document management system (Sat 22 March, 7am-11am)
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The firm's document management system and remote desktop will be unavailable this Saturday 22 March between 07:00 and 11:00 for scheduled maintenance and security patching. Please save and close all documents before Friday evening. Email will be unaffected.

If you have an urgent weekend deadline, contact the IT duty line.

IT Helpdesk | Whitfield Carter LLP
